faqs.a:
Pursuant to C.R.S. § 31-16-101 et seq. and the Arvada City Charter, the International
               Swimming Pool and Spa Code, 2018 Edition, published by the International Code Council,
               5203 Leesburg Pike, Suite 600, Falls Church, VA 22041, is hereby adopted by reference
               and incorporated into the Arvada City Code.
The International Swimming Pool and Spa Code shall be known as the "I.S.P.S.C." and
               may be referred to as such.
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 13, 9-14-2020)
